thread:
Ana: Noticed P95 spike on hosted streaming after today's framer change. CPU on host-side up ~10%, traces point to tokenization + repeated parse work.
Ben: Which framer change? We swapped the big-copy path to 'slimfrag' earlier. Could that increase micro-fragmentation?
Ana: Yep. Slimfrag avoids copies for large frames but sends more tiny chunks to the tokenizer. Short TCP/gRPC writes ~100-300B now trigger tokenize repeatedly.
Rui: Can you paste a quick pprof top?
Ana: pprof snapshot (30s):
```
pprof top
11.3% tokenizer::stream_tokenize
9.0% ingress::partial_unmarshal
6.5% grpc::writev_small
4.8% kvcache::miss_path_accounting
3.6% mem::slab_alloc
```
Nora: Looks like reduced KV-prefix reuse too. Miss rate +5% on those hosts. That compounds latency.
Ben: Short-term: increase ingress coalesce window (256->2048) or fall back to legacy framer on streaming endpoints. Longer: tweak slimfrag small-write threshold or add a tokenizer micro-accumulator.
Rui: Also instrument kernel selection in the runtime. If batch shapes moved to many single-token batches, GPU kernels may be suboptimal. Need histogram of selected kernels during the spike.
Ana: Quick canary: bumped read-buffer to 2048 + disabled slimfrag on one host. T+12m: P95 down ~8%, kv miss back to normal, CPU down.
PerfBot: @deploy-bot rolled back slimfrag on canary (job 2057012390) :white_check_mark:
Nora: OK assign tasks: Ana run 1h A/B; Ben add kernel-selection + kv-reuse metrics; Rui prototype tokenizer prefix-hold; Perf team add nightly microbench for streaming 1-8 token tails.
Ana: Starting A/B now, will upload flamegraphs and kernel histograms.
Ben: If buffer bump holds, we can roll regionally and then revisit slimfrag thresholding. Also add CI perf tests that simulate small-fragment streams.
Ana: Update T+30m: canary stable, keeping the A/B for the hour. Will post artifacts when done. End thread.
